svg.text: Domain schema on MySQL 8 · types, nullability, keys and delete rules read from the live database · billing tables excluded
slug is the route key — public, shareable URLs
slug unique per course · required_plan null = inherit it
one row per pilot per mission · best_score and stars only rise
append-only — no updated_at, nothing revises a graded run
WebAuthn credentials, one pilot to many devices
unique on (course_id, slug), as challenges are
explanation is withheld from the client until graded
is_correct is the answer key — never serialised
passed_at is set once — a retake cannot revoke a pass
append-only · counts only, the chosen answers are not stored
path points at a private disk — served by expiring URL only
seeded fleet · exactly one row carries is_default
one ▸ many, ON DELETE SET NULL
